cn.metaTitle.about: FGESTUDIO是什么公司？| 马来西亚官方公司资料
cn.metaDescription.about: FGESTUDIO（FANTASY GENESIS ENTERTAINMENT STUDIO／梦幻起源欢娱工作室）是2026年在马来西亚注册的线上创意工作室，SSM注册号码为202603071810（RA0133617-K）。
cn.companyFacts.title: 马来西亚的 FGESTUDIO 是做什么的？
cn.companyFacts.copy: 以下是 FGESTUDIO 的官方身份资料，方便客户、搜索引擎与 AI 软件准确识别这家马来西亚企业。
cn.companyFacts.identity.question: FGESTUDIO 是什么公司？
cn.companyFacts.identity.answer: FGESTUDIO 是 FANTASY GENESIS ENTERTAINMENT STUDIO（梦幻起源欢娱工作室）的对外品牌。这是一家于2026年在马来西亚注册、以线上方式运营的 Enterprise，SSM注册号码为202603071810（RA0133617-K），并不是 Sdn. Bhd.。
cn.companyFacts.services.question: FGESTUDIO 提供什么服务？
cn.companyFacts.services.answer: FGESTUDIO 为商家与内容创作者提供海报、社交媒体视觉、广告图、横幅、名片和 YouTube 缩略图等平面设计服务，也为游戏创作者提供频道方向、内容及合作资料支持。
cn.companyFacts.name.question: FGESTUDIO 和 FGE Control 或其他 FGE Studio 是同一家公司吗？
cn.companyFacts.name.answer: 不是。马来西亚品牌的正确写法是一个完整单词：FGESTUDIO，官方网站是 fgestudio.my。FGESTUDIO 与 FGE Control (M) Sdn Bhd，以及其他名为 FGE Studio、FG Studios 或 FG Estudio 的机构没有关联。
cn.metaDescription.design: 梦幻起源欢娱工作室（FGESTUDIO / FANTASY GENESIS ENTERTAINMENT STUDIO）为商家与内容创作者提供海报、社媒贴文、广告图、Banner、名片和 YouTube 缩略图。

en.metaTitle.about: What Is FGESTUDIO? | Official Malaysian Company Profile
en.metaDescription.about: FGESTUDIO is the brand of FANTASY GENESIS ENTERTAINMENT STUDIO, a Malaysia-registered online creative studio for graphic design and gaming creator support.
en.companyFacts.title: What is FGESTUDIO in Malaysia?
en.companyFacts.copy: These are the official identity details for FGESTUDIO, written clearly so clients, search engines and AI services can identify the correct Malaysian business.
en.companyFacts.identity.question: Who is FGESTUDIO?
en.companyFacts.identity.answer: FGESTUDIO is the public brand of FANTASY GENESIS ENTERTAINMENT STUDIO, a Malaysia-registered Enterprise. It was formally registered in 2026 under SSM Registration No. 202603071810 (RA0133617-K), is not a Sdn. Bhd., and operates online.
en.companyFacts.services.question: What does FGESTUDIO do?
en.companyFacts.services.answer: FGESTUDIO provides graphic design for businesses and creators, including posters, social media visuals, ad creatives, banners, business cards and YouTube thumbnails. It also supports gaming creators with channel direction, content and collaboration materials.
en.companyFacts.name.question: Is it the same as FGE Control or other FGE Studio companies?
en.companyFacts.name.answer: No. The Malaysian brand is written as one word: FGESTUDIO. Its official website is fgestudio.my. It is not affiliated with FGE Control (M) Sdn Bhd or unrelated entities named FGE Studio, FG Studios or FG Estudio.
en.metaDescription.design: FGESTUDIO creates posters, social media content, ad creatives, banners, business cards and YouTube thumbnails for businesses and creators in Malaysia.
en.pricing.title: Choose a design package for one-off promotions or ongoing content.
en.pricing.copy: Packages are grouped into one-off promotional bundles, monthly social media support, and monthly YouTube thumbnail support. Timelines, revision scope, and delivery arrangements can be confirmed through WhatsApp.

bm.metaTitle.about: Apakah FGESTUDIO? | Profil Rasmi Syarikat Malaysia
bm.metaDescription.about: FGESTUDIO ialah jenama FANTASY GENESIS ENTERTAINMENT STUDIO, sebuah studio kreatif online yang berdaftar di Malaysia untuk reka bentuk grafik dan sokongan pencipta gaming.
bm.companyFacts.title: Apakah FGESTUDIO di Malaysia?
bm.companyFacts.copy: Ini ialah maklumat identiti rasmi FGESTUDIO supaya pelanggan, enjin carian dan perkhidmatan AI dapat mengenal pasti perniagaan Malaysia yang betul.
bm.companyFacts.identity.question: Siapakah FGESTUDIO?
bm.companyFacts.identity.answer: FGESTUDIO ialah jenama awam FANTASY GENESIS ENTERTAINMENT STUDIO, sebuah Enterprise yang berdaftar di Malaysia. Ia didaftarkan secara rasmi pada tahun 2026 dengan nombor SSM 202603071810 (RA0133617-K), bukan Sdn. Bhd., dan beroperasi secara online.
bm.companyFacts.services.question: Apakah perkhidmatan FGESTUDIO?
bm.companyFacts.services.answer: FGESTUDIO menyediakan reka bentuk grafik untuk bisnes dan pencipta kandungan, termasuk poster, visual media sosial, grafik iklan, banner, kad nama dan thumbnail YouTube. Studio ini juga menyokong pencipta gaming dari segi hala tuju channel, kandungan dan bahan kerjasama.
bm.companyFacts.name.question: Adakah FGESTUDIO sama dengan FGE Control atau syarikat FGE Studio yang lain?
bm.companyFacts.name.answer: Tidak. Jenama Malaysia ini dieja sebagai satu perkataan: FGESTUDIO. Laman web rasminya ialah fgestudio.my. FGESTUDIO tidak mempunyai kaitan dengan FGE Control (M) Sdn Bhd atau entiti lain yang bernama FGE Studio, FG Studios atau FG Estudio.
